strings.name: Ken Thompson
strings.role: Unix co-creator · Programming languages and systems
strings.summary: At Bell Labs, Ken Thompson and Dennis Ritchie established Unix, helping make small, composable software tools central to computing practice. Thompson also designed B, co-designed UTF-8 with Rob Pike, and developed Go with Pike and Robert Griesemer. His work spans operating systems, text encoding and programming tools, with lasting effects on software infrastructure.
strings.coverageNote: Research checked through 13 November 2026; selected milestones extend to 2025. This is not a daily news record. Shared achievements are credited to collaborators and teams.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-created Unix and helped design Go, profoundly influencing operating systems, programming tools and modern software infrastructure.

strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Foundations of Unix
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Developed Unix with Dennis Ritchie, advancing multi-user operating systems and their tools.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Shared software infrastructure
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Co-designed UTF-8 and Go, supporting multilingual text processing and systems development.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Oral history published
strings.timeline.event-1.text: The Computer History Museum released an oral history covering Unix, B and Go.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Japan Prize
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Shared the prize with Dennis Ritchie for their development of Unix and its contributions.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Go became open source
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Go, designed with Rob Pike and Robert Griesemer, was opened to the public.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Co-designed UTF-8
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Worked with Rob Pike on an ASCII-compatible encoding for Unicode.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Turing Award
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Shared the 1983 ACM Turing Award with Dennis Ritchie.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: Created Unix
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Implemented an early Unix at Bell Labs and continued its development with Ritchie.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: Master’s degree and Bell Labs
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Completed graduate study at Berkeley and moved into systems research at Bell Labs.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Berkeley bachelor’s degree
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Completed undergraduate study in electrical engineering and computer science.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Born in New Orleans
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Born in New Orleans, Louisiana, United States.
